title: FinRL-DeepSeek: LLM-Infused Risk-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning for Trading Agents

claim.summary: FinRL-DeepSeek injects LLM-derived financial-news recommendation and risk scores into PPO/CVaR-PPO stock trading rather than training the LLM or replacing the RL policy with an LLM planner.

modules.name: News-conditioned trading-action scaling
modules.scope_reason: LLM news scores multiply stock trading actions according to recommendation polarity.
evidence_locators: PDF p.2; passage beginning "In LLM-infused PPO, we compute stock-specific"

modules.name: News-conditioned portfolio-risk return modulation
modules.scope_reason: Stock-level language risk scores are portfolio-weighted and multiply trajectory returns in CVaR-PPO.
evidence_locators: PDF p.2; passage beginning "Financial news from the FNSPID dataset is processed with an LLM to generate risk scores"
